div.div:
Who does what: ❶ edge validation — shared flow, centrally patched (0 service redeploys), structurally unskippable via flow hook ❷ hop identity minted per target (cached) ❸ platform IAM gate — the answer to "why can't someone just call the service over PGA?" ❹ zero-trust revalidation in-service ❺ resource-level authz — only possible where claims meet application data
Perf rule (§8): nothing on the warm path makes a synchronous external call — JWKS cached, minted tokens cached, revocation via pushed deny-list, per-request introspection rejected.
